 Juventus Lecce Serie A Lecce vs Juventus Follow Lecce-Juventus, a match in the eighth round of Serie A
 Lecce-Juventus comes with a lengthy injury list and three crucial points at stake for both sides. The penultimate match of Serie A 2026/2027's eighth round kicks off at 18:00 at the Via del Mare in the Salento capital. 
 In three days, Eusebio Di Francesco's Lecce have lost three key starters: Coulibaly, Ilici and Pierotti. The hosts must build on their good form, and a win would take them above Luciano Spalletti's Juventus . Spalletti is on "a hot seat", in the words of chief executive Carnevali. Juventus have gone two league matches without a win, lost Nico Gonzalez and Celik to injury and come into the game after a controversial Europa League draw against Rennes.
